question: Does J0754 exhibit a stable dominant cycle at the catalogue period912.3158778days?
authorship: Ari proposed the question; Kyle submitted and authorized it, signed -Ari.
status: Written before fitting/scanning periods in this stage. The broad2018–2022fading and later recovery have already been inspected, so this is not a blind test.
scope: Test a coherent dominant clock; failure does not exclude a weak/quasiperiodic912-daycomponent beneath larger changes.

preprocessing.native_screen: Reuse previously defined ASAS-SN parse_row acceptance; no brightness clipping. Keep V/g separate. Principal ZTF differential stream only, all364points retained before time selection.
preprocessing.primary_dates: Post2019g-band ASAS-SN and ZTF, independent of the older V catalogue fitting data. Retain all5ASAS-SN g cameras; no outcome selection.
preprocessing.binning: UTC-date medians, then medians in fixed30-day bins indexed from catalogue epoch. One bin per camera/stream; unweighted bins avoid dense-camera/night dominance.
preprocessing.offsets: Single constant offset per camera across all cycles. No year/cycle centering, detrending or phase shifts to force alignment.

models.periodic: Nominal fixed period with shared g-band sine/cosine coefficients; one harmonic primary and two-harmonic flexibility check. Free phase/amplitude, constant across cycles.
models.slow_reference: Piecewise-linear curve with5time-only equally spaced knots across each dataset and camera constants. Same9parameter count as two-harmonic five-camera periodic model. Descriptive reference, not a physical model.
models.old_V: Fit old222Vobservations separately for provenance; they are not independent validation.
models.forecast: Fit data before2023-01-01, predict2023onward without phase/amplitude/offset refitting.
models.blocked_cv: Leave out each90-day time block across all cameras together; refit on others and score withheld bins.

phase_replay.matching: Same camera, one-to-one nearest matches in time only; no magnitude-based selection. Compare bins separated by2P. Record all pairs and per-camera diagnostics.

scans.nearby: ±10% around nominal, period selected on pre2023training only for forecast.
scans.exploratory: 4096frequencies covering200–6000days. Inspect aliases/window; no white-noise false-alarm probability or precise replacement-period claim.

cadence_positive_control.signal: 0.30mag peak-to-peak sinusoid at912.3158778days, random phase; actual bin times/cameras.
cadence_positive_control.noise: 0.03mag Gaussian shared per90-day block plus0.04mag independent perbin; total0.05mag. Conditional power check, not a fitted noise model or observed false-alarm probability.

decision.support: Dominant coherent model should explain>=50%of camera-centered variance, improve blocked-CV and forward forecast RMSE by>=20%, and give consistent independent ZTF behavior. These are practical dominance/prediction thresholds, not a p-value.
decision.failure: Nominal/nearby cycle is not supported as dominant if both surveys explain<50%variance, fail to reach20%predictive gains, and same-phase two-cycle RMS exceeds0.10mag and the95thpercentile of stable-signal simulations. Otherwise report mixed/inconclusive rather than force a verdict.
decision.limitations: Camera/systematic effects and correlated errors remain. A longer favored scale over few cycles is not a measured replacement period; no rotation/orbit/dust mechanism follows.
